svg.data-weight: 6.5 kg with no power supply, fan module or extension module (EX4400-24T); 5.36 kg for the -S
svg.data-depth-with-modules: 430.0 mm with power supply and fan modules; 440.7 mm with an extension module as well
svg.data-mounting: two-post kit EX-RMK in the box; four-post kit EX-4PST-RMK and wall kit EX-WMK separate
svg.data-power-redundancy: 1+1 with two supplies of one type
svg.data-heat-dissipation: 300.08 BTU/hr idle and 313.72 at 100 percent traffic with a 550 W AC supply; 320.54 and 337.59 with a 550 W DC supply
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 45 C (32 F to 113 F)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C (-40 F to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 40 C
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 42.7 dB(A) typical with one 550 W AC supply and front-to-back airflow (ISO 7779, from the front at 23 C)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches over the QSFP28 ports, which are Virtual Chassis ports by default
svg.data-macsec: AES-256 on all RJ-45, SFP and SFP+ network ports and the SFP28 and QSFP28 extension module ports
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: The two rear ports take 100GbE QSFP28 or 40GbE QSFP+ transceivers (40G from Junos OS 22.1R1). Breakout cables give 4x25G and 4x10G. The exact list is in the Hardware Compatibility Tool
svg.data-qsfp28-channelization: each QSFP28 port runs as 100G, as 40G from Junos OS 22.1R1, or channelized
svg.data-extension-slot: one slot for the EX4400-EM-4S, EX4400-EM-4Y or EX4400-EM-1C module
svg.data-console: USB-C on the front and RJ-45 (CON) on the rear
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 on the rear, 10/100/1000, with link activity and status lamps
svg.data-cloud: Juniper Mist Wired Assurance, and the Junos CLI and J-Web
svg.data-seismic: Tested for Zone 4 earthquake according to NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 5
